restrictions: Two-block attack on fixed-IV SHA-256 reduced to steps 0..30 (full feed-forward, full 256-bit digest, standard padding). Messages M0||M1 and M0||M1', 128 bytes each; M1' = M1 + DW word-wise with DW nonzero only in words 5..9, DW5..9 = (00000ffa, 001f77ef, b00fb5fa, d800f100, 00008004), the difference of the characteristic that phase P of the algorithm itself finds.

Every phase runs inside one execution of the shipped algorithm: P-model generation, the characteristic search P (one STP+CryptoMiniSat call), exact sets, the base starting point M (one solver call), local search, tables and the rate model that sets N = 2/q, and the online phase. Each phase runs under a retired-instruction budget enforced by the shipped driver (a kill is a failed run) and is charged at budget + overshoot (100 ms at 5e10 instr/s per thread) x a measured per-instruction price (solver 6, our C 5..17 word ops per AArch64 instruction). The prefix is deterministic; the time is the exact sum of the budgets, the counted SWAR online batches at N and the hit path at its caps (proof Section 2).

One declared cost premise, P1 (proof Section 4; heuristic H-P1): the seven search-model constants fixed as literals in [LLW24]'s public search program (Peace9911/sha_2_attack@6a9f35fd: HW(dW16)=17, HW(dW18)=2, HW(dE12)=HW(dE14)=2, dE13=0, HW(dE11|dE12)=5, message weight 48) are public algorithm text used without time charge and declared as 2^3 bytes of advice. All seven are quantities of the published characteristic, which the r31 record 50592e75 (PR #467) uses in full without time charge (its H1, plausible in all four lanes; 2^9 bytes of advice). Disclosed: gate G0 showed the constants are load-bearing; our unsubmitted v5 charged an allowance for them. With P1 charged on that basis (1.06e15 solver instructions at price 6) the time is 2^41.45; at price 9, 2^42.03. Besides P1, the development-fixed constants of premise P2 are disclosed with their ledger and sensitivities; no other advice.

Online: 7-lane SWAR (tekkac 7x36 packing; counted batch 2,235 primitives per 7 trials), fresh first block per trial from 16 AES-128-CTR words under the run's random key; keys looked up in a full 2^32-bit bitmap; every candidate re-hashed from the IV before output.

heuristics.statement: One run of the frozen algorithm (deterministic prefix, online phase with a fresh uniformly random AES key and trial cap N = 3,510,010,448) outputs a pair of distinct messages with equal 31-step SHA-256 digests with probability at least 0.40.
heuristics.scope: Only the success probability. Cost does not depend on H-SUCC: every phase is budgeted or capped in code and charged at the budget/cap; every output is re-hashed and checked.
heuristics.extrapolation: Direct measurement of the full success event by the shipped program: pre-registered (PREREG2; frozen-file hash list, sha256 b6980f24..., written before the root seed was drawn) 100 online runs on the E-C prefix with keys derived from the root seed gave 91 verified collisions (one-sided 99.5% Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.8108; per-run table in Appendix A); the pre-registered full-chain run E-C also succeeded. All 92 pairs verified with the official verifier; 16 are the certificates and all 92 are returned by the organizer experiment v6-pairs-and-swar-batch. In-algorithm model: 1 - e^-2 = 0.86; realised per-trial rate 2^-30.640 vs model 2^-30.709; success times consistent with an exponential (KS D = 0.124 < 0.143 at 5%).
heuristics.limitations: Participant runs on one reference machine (Apple M5 Pro, the frozen binaries and solver library hashes of Appendix B), not organizer-executed (the online phase needs ~2^31 trials and a 2^32-bit bitmap). A machine reboot interrupted run 85 of 100 after 84 runs (k = 78/84 already met the rule); the remaining keys ran exactly as pre-registered after a hashed resume note (proof Section 3). Premise: AES-128-CTR under a fresh random key behaves as the random-word primitive. The statement is for this frozen prefix (deterministic: identical outputs in 5 runs).

heuristics.statement: The seven [LLW24] search-model constants of premise P1 (HW(dW16)=17, HW(dW18)=2, HW(dE12)=HW(dE14)=2, dE13=0, HW(dE11|dE12)=5, message weight 48) are public algorithm text that the algorithm may use without charging their original discovery: they are literals of the public, pinned search program and quantities of the published characteristic. They are seven integers, not a characteristic, collision, message word, chaining value or state value.
heuristics.scope: Only the time (and preprocessing) claim; success probability and all other charges are unaffected. The seven constants only: the program's fixed signed A and E patterns are not used, no published characteristic, starting point, first block or colliding pair is used, and the characteristic is searched in-chain and charged. Claim 2^33.47 under H-P1; with P1 charged on our unsubmitted v5's allowance basis 2^41.45 at solver price 6 and 2^42.03 at price 9 (proof Section 2, sensitivity rows).
heuristics.extrapolation: The constants are literals of Peace9911/sha_2_attack@6a9f35fd, find_dc/correct_dc_model_31_256.py (lines 71, 78, 156, 163, 170, 184, 193); that file also fixes signed patterns for A5..A10 and E8..E14, which our generator sets to empty (marked r31v6), so only the seven weights are inherited. All seven equal the corresponding quantities of the published characteristic (proof Section 4, P1 provenance), which the r31 record 50592e75 (jungjipdo; PR #467, merged 2026-10-07) uses in full without time charge under the same form of heuristic (its H1-public-characteristic, plausible in all four lanes). Our search output 8_14 (A-weight 20) differs from the published characteristic in its A, E and W rows, and every phase from the characteristic search to the online phase is executed, budgeted and charged in-chain (proof Sections 1-3).
heuristics.limitations: The characteristic-search effort behind the constants is not executed or bounded by our evidence; gate G0 (two characteristic-search calls without the six weight constants) failed, so the constants are load-bearing. All seven are quantities of the published characteristic. Our v5 (never submitted) charged an allowance for them; a charge of T units adds T to the 1.18525e10-unit total, and v5's allowance gives the P1-charged totals 2^41.45 (price 6) and 2^42.03 (price 9) stated next to the claim.
